'''Asgard Private Military Corporation''' was a Khalindarian private military company formed in 1986 under [[Emperor Mikael Khalindar IV]]. It was designed as a proxy force for the [[Empire of Khalindar]].

== Purpose ==

Asgard allowed Khalindar to build, test, and deploy force outside normal army channels. Its semi-private status gave the empire deniability while still serving imperial goals.

The organization belongs to the late-1980s escalation period that preceded the [[Solara-Khalindar War]]. It reflected Khalindar's growing willingness to use indirect force while the [[Khalindarian reparations dispute]] remained unresolved.

== Status During The War ==

The source archive does not yet define Asgard's full wartime order of battle. Its known significance is institutional: it shows how Khalindar prepared proxy and irregular instruments before open war with Solara.

== Post-1994 Source Note ==

Old source material says Asgard's relationship to the empire was debated until a later merger into Khalindar around a 1998 imperial collapse. Because this porting batch is scoped to 1994 and back, that later fate is preserved only as an old-source note and should be confirmed before publication as canon.
